articles.title: Deputy Minister of Defenсe of the Russian Federation Vasily Osmakov receives Chief of General Staff of Armed Forces of Mongolia Lieutenant General Sunrev Ganbyamba
articles.summary: On April 16, 2026, Russia's Deputy Minister of Defence, Vasily Osmakov, met with Lieutenant General Sunrev Ganbyamba, Chief of General Staff of the Armed Forces of Mongolia. This high-level engagement between top military officials signifies ongoing bilateral defence cooperation. Such interactions are crucial for fostering international military relations and strategic partnerships, relevant for understanding geopolitical dynamics.
